notes.title: Hats and Guns demo now available! 🤠
notes.content:
Come and try the Hats and Guns demo 🌵
Two years after the start of our first game, we are glad to present our first demo.

The main game systems are in place, but we are still working on many new features. We plan to update this demo regularly until the game is released.

We hope you enjoy this demo!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45260904/b3bc63f5b5f27037b6f526d62f31a0a9030785a3.png"]
Join us on Discord ! Join the Discord
We’d love to hear your feedback and chat with you. If you enjoyed our demo, feel free to join our Discord. That way, you can follow the development of Hats and Guns more closely. 🤠
